# Pulsely

> > Pulsely is a people analytics and DEI consulting platform that combines AI-powered culture measurement with expert-led inclusion strategy implementation.

Pulsely offers an integrated suite of products and consulting services designed to help organizations measure, understand, and improve workplace culture, belonging, and inclusion. The platform serves clients across North America and Europe with offices in Lisbon and London.

## Key Topics

- People Analytics
- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DEI)
- Workplace Culture
- Psychological Safety
- Inclusive Leadership
- Belonging & Engagement
- Culture Assessment
- Anonymous Feedback
- Workplace Inclusion Diagnostic
- Survey Platform
- HR Analytics
- Leadership Development
- Employee Engagement
- Culture Measurement
- Inclusion Consulting

## Core Platform

- [People Analytics Platform](https://pulsely.io/people-analytics-platform): Main product page for Pulsely's people analytics platform with AI-powered HR insights.
- [People Analytics](https://pulsely.io/features/people-analytics): Product feature page highlighting People Analytics, Belonging Pulse, and ESG reporting capabilities.
- [Culture Pulse](https://pulsely.io/features/culture-pulse): Product feature page for Culture Pulse survey platform measuring workplace culture and belonging.
- [Inclusive Leadership Culture Assessment](https://pulsely.io/features/inclusive-leadership-culture-assessment): Product feature page for Inclusive Leadership Culture Assessment tool and survey platform.
- [Anonymous Chat](https://pulsely.io/features/anonymous-chat): Product feature page for Anonymous Chat tool enabling confidential employee feedback and psychological safety.

## Consulting Services

- [Consulting](https://pulsely.io/consulting/inclusion-consulting-services): Main consulting services page for Pulsely's data-driven inclusion and DEI consulting offerings.
- [Workplace Inclusion Diagnostic](https://pulsely.io/consulting/workplace-inclusion-diagnostic): Consulting service page for Workplace Inclusion Diagnostic based on Pulsely's 7 pillars of inclusion.
- [Build Leadership Excellence](https://pulsely.io/consulting/inclusion-culture-survey): Consulting service page for Inclusive Culture Survey focused on leadership development and assessment.
